biography: Stephen Moore, a name whispered with a mix of admiration and apprehension in the Ginetta paddock, hails from a small village nestled in the Cotswolds. His racing journey began not on a track, but on the muddy fields surrounding his family's farm. At the age of 10, he built his first makeshift kart from scrap metal and a lawnmower engine, terrorizing local livestock and honing his innate sense of car control. A local mechanic, witnessing Stephen's raw talent during one of these escapades, sponsored him for a karting championship, where he quickly made a name for himself with aggressive overtaking maneuvers and an unwavering commitment to the podium. His transition to Ginetta racing was meteoric, securing a rookie championship in his debut season. Now, at 25, Stephen is on the cusp of greatness, his ambition burning brighter than ever, fueled by a hunger to conquer every challenge.
drivingStyle: Moore's driving style is a blend of calculated aggression and raw talent. He is known for his late braking and daring overtakes, often pushing his car to the absolute limit. He is particularly adept at adapting to changing track conditions, using his instinctive feel for grip to gain an advantage. While his aggressive approach sometimes leads to mistakes, it is also what makes him a thrilling and unpredictable racer.
